transforms.code:
def buildTimeCol(timeValue, timeUnits):
		if (timeValue or 0) == 0: return ''
		return '{:,} {}'.format(round(timeValue,1), timeUnits)

	def buildCount(countValue, countUnits, isRate):
		if (countValue or 0) == 0: return ''
		countUnits = list(set(countUnits))
		countUnit = 'Mixed Units' if len(countUnits) > 1 else countUnits[0]
		return '{:,} {} {}'.format(round(countValue,1), countUnit, 'per min' if isRate else '')

	def buildFootCol(title, span, justify, fontWeight):
		return {"title": title, "span": span, "justify": justify, "align": "center", "style": {"classes": "", 'padding':'0px', 'backgroundColor': bgColor, 'color': foreColor, 'fontWeight': fontWeight}}
	
	if len(value['filterData']) > 0:
		data = value['filterData']
	else:
		data = (value['data'])

	if len(data) == 0: return []
	
	infeedCount = 0.0
	outfeedCount = 0.0
	wasteCount = 0.0
	infeedUnits = []
	outfeedUnits = []
	wasteUnits = []
	actualMins = 0.0
	rtMins = 0.0
	dtMins = 0.0
	pdtMins = 0.0
	
	bgColor = '--kcGray-10'
	foreColor = system.kanoa.utilities.getContrastingColor(bgColor)
	
	for row in data:
		if row['modeName']['value'] != 'Production': continue
		
		if row['rawInfeedCount']: 
			infeedCount += row['rawInfeedCount'] or 0.0
			if row['infeedUnits']: infeedUnits.append(row['infeedUnits'])
		
		if row['rawOutfeedCount']: 
			outfeedCount += row['rawOutfeedCount'] or 0.0
			if row['outfeedUnits']: outfeedUnits.append(row['outfeedUnits'])

		if row['rawWasteCount']: 
			wasteCount += row['rawWasteCount'] or 0.0
			if row['wasteUnits']: wasteUnits.append(row['wasteUnits'])
			
		actualMins += row['actualMins'] or 0.0
		rtMins += row['runMins'] or 0.0
		dtMins = row['dtMins'] or 0.0
		pdtMins = row['pdtMins'] or 0.0
	
	infeedRate = infeedCount / rtMins if rtMins > 0 else 0

	footers = []
	footers.append(buildFootCol('Total', 4, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(infeedCount, infeedUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(outfeedCount, outfeedUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(wasteCount, wasteUnits, False), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol('', 2, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(actualMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(rtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(dtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildTimeCol(pdtMins, ''), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol(buildCount(infeedRate, infeedUnits, True), 1, 'right', 'bold'))
	footers.append(buildFootCol('', 2, 'right', 'bold'))
	
	return [footers]

#	return len(value or []) > self.props.pager.initialOption
	return True

customMethods.name: openDetailViewer
customMethods.script:
row = self.view.custom.table.selection.row
	data = self.view.custom.table.data

	startDate = data[row]['startDate'] if self.view.custom.filters.byShift else data[row]['runStart']
	endDate = data[row]['endDate'] if self.view.custom.filters.byShift else data[row]['runEnd']
	
	params = {'value':{'assetId': data.getValueAt(row, 'assetId'), 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate}}
	system.perspective.openPopup('detailViewer', 'kanoa/mes/asset/runReview/runViewer', params, title='Production Details', draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True)
	
	return

customMethods.name: openProductionReport
customMethods.script:
row = self.view.custom.table.selection.row
	data = self.view.custom.table.data
	workOrderSelected = data.getValueAt(row, 'workOrderName')
	workOrderId = data.getValueAt(row, 'workOrderId')
	if workOrderSelected is None: return
	
	assetId = data.getValueAt(row, 'assetId')
	reportPath = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('assetAttrValue', system.kanoa.asset.getAssetAttributes({'assetId': assetId, 'assetAttrName': '_productionReportViewPath'})) or "kanoa/mes/analytics/productionReport"
	
	params= {'value': {'workOrderName': workOrderSelected, 'workOrderId': workOrderId}}

	system.perspective.openPopup('productionReport', reportPath, params, title='Production Report', draggable=True, resizable=True, showCloseIcon=True)

customMethods.name: getData
customMethods.script:
filters = self.view.custom.filters
	if filters['workOrderId'] is None: return []
	self.view.custom.table.gettingData = True	
	
	if filters['byShift']: data = system.kanoa.event.getAssetProductionEventsByShift(filters)
	else: data = system.kanoa.event.getAssetProductionEvents(filters)

	self.view.custom.table.data = system.dataset.toPyDataSet(system.dataset.sort(data, 'startDate', False))
	
	self.view.custom.table.gettingData = False	
	
	return
